attachments.title: Documents
attachments.previewUnsupported: Inline preview is available for images and PDFs. Use Download for other file types.
attachments.linkSelectPlaceholder: Choose a document already in this organization…
attachments.unlinkBody: The file stays in the organization. Only this record’s link is removed.
attachments.deleteBody: The file is soft-deleted for the organization and removed from storage when possible. This cannot be undone from the product UI.
attachments.dropzone: Drop a file here, or use Upload. On phones, Take photo opens the camera.

ocr.title: OCR review
ocr.description: Review receipt candidates before anything reaches expenses. OCR is never ledger truth on its own.
ocr.providerNotConfigured: No OCR provider credentials are configured. Extraction will not invent amounts — configure OCR_PROVIDER_API_KEY when a real provider is ready.
ocr.providerConfiguredStub: An OCR API key is present, but the stub provider still does not extract receipt data. Wire a real provider adapter when ready.
ocr.honesty: Candidates below are proposals only. Accept fields individually, then confirm — OCR is never ledger truth on its own.
ocr.empty: No extracted receipts waiting for review. Seed a fixture candidate to try the review flow, or run extraction once a provider is connected.
ocr.fixtureSeeded: Fixture candidate added for review (not from OCR).
ocr.extractQueuedReview: Extraction finished with candidates — review and confirm before any expense is created.
ocr.extractFailed: Extraction failed ({code}). No expense was created.
ocr.mappedOnly: Mapping preview saved. No expense was created — confirm explicitly to create a draft.
ocr.expenseCreated: Draft expense created: {id} (not finalized / not ledger-posted).
ocr.notAllowed: You do not have permission to review document extraction.
ocr.acceptRequired: Accept at least one field before mapping or creating an expense.
ocr.sourceRetained: Original file metadata is retained on this job. Candidates are not ledger truth until you confirm a draft expense.
ocr.lineDescriptionsHint: Display only — copy into description if needed. Never auto-posted.
ocr.suggestionsHint: Labels only — never written as project or category IDs.
ocr.noCandidates: No candidates available for this job.
